scripts.build: npm run build -w @skygem/shared && npm run build -w @skygem/api && npm run build -w @skygem/portal
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @skygem/shared && npm run typecheck -w @skygem/api && npm run typecheck -w @skygem/portal
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test -w @skygem/api
scripts.dev:api: npm run build -w @skygem/shared && npm run dev -w @skygem/api
scripts.dev:portal: npm run build -w @skygem/shared && npm run dev -w @skygem/portal
